notes: Blessed after 13 fix rounds. Gate ran local DB probes (SQLite journal_mode, PostgreSQL transaction_status, FATAL 57P01 commit semantics) that materially changed the design: PostgreSQL-only joins in v1, fresh-transaction hygiene ROLLBACK before BEGIN, session-owned guarded connection with short borrows (no stored borrowing Transaction), rollback-only admission closure after joined DB/prepare errors, CommitFailed reserved for definitive rejection (PG deferred FK 23503), CommitUncertain for connection-fatal outcomes, observable cancellation cutoff at driver handoff.
